lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Something wonderful just happened!
What happened?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: You know that new outfit I got?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Everyone's been saying it really suits me, hehe!
Yeah, it really looks good on you.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Hehe, thank you!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I don't know why, but I feel kind of giddy!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Wearing a new outfit like this

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: reminds me of when I first started working.
Your first day of work? How was it?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Hehe, I was shaking so much!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I was excited and nervous at the same time!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Before work, I kept checking my outfit over and over,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: making sure nothing was wrinkled

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: and my hair wasn't sticking out anywhere.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I thought I'd feel better once I got to work,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: but actually... the moment I arrived, I got even more nervous.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Hehe, I couldn't stop worrying about every little thing!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Did I greet everyone properly,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: maintain my smile,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: make sure my voice didn't shake...

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: it was like my mind was on every tiny detail at once.
You had moments like that, too?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Of course, hehe!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Back then, I was a complete rookie too.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Everyone has a first time, right?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I made plenty of mistakes at first...
It's hard to imagine.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Oh my, hehe! Really?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: This is a secret I'm only sharing with you, Commander.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Truth is, I still slip up every now and then.
Huh? You do?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Yeah, hehe!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: It's not a big mistake like before,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: and it doesn't happen every day,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: so you'd hardly notice it!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I guess I've gotten a little better at it!
Looks like you're getting more experienced.
By the way, aren't you supposed to be working right now?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Oh my, you're right!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: It's already time for the next departure!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Hehe, thanks for the reminder, Commander!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: If it weren't for you, I almost would've made a big mistake.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I'll be in touch again soon!
